page.notes: Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. The first line of the page may continue a paragraph from the previous page; cont="true" is a judgement from the sense. The word "filij" (ij) is read as printed but the final letter is slightly blurred. "Potestne" has an accent over the e in the scan, not reproduced. The heading "QVIS EST DECIMVS" carries no caput number because the printed ordinal is not a plain numeral. The catchword "stamen." is read from the foot right of the page. Ornamental rule between the two blocks is not text.
